trigger: Sam requested continuing with the preview controller, testing against baseline, seeing it in Isaac Sim, and checking GitHub road/progress availability.
phase: bounded synthetic development comparison; inspected seed, not held-out confirmation
controller: Every controlled car uses current reachable same/adjacent-path forward projections. Latch preview braking when any known h2 envelope margin falls below 10 m. While latched cap the native ACC request at -2.5 m/s2; release after all currently assessed margins exceed 20 m for 1 s (no candidates also permits release if ego context is known). Unknown initial response profiles do not become clear: retain an existing latch; baseline safety remains active. No intent, route label, actor name or event schedule is an input. The same measured-acceleration jerk filter applies; a discrete-speed release guard prevents continuing braking past a recoverable near-stop state. Report guard conflicts when existing native acceleration already makes the jerk-limited release infeasible.
baseline: Reuse all six hash-verified original smooth-ACC runs. Re-run ramp-44 once with the edited runner and require the complete canonical trace to match the frozen baseline before new treatment runs.
matrix: Six cases at each of two ranges, plus two primary repeats and one unchanged-baseline regression: 15 bounded simulations. Preserve all failed cases and forbid outcome-driven parameter tuning within v1.
metrics: Paired maximum/RMS jerk, exceedance/mismatch counts, native gaps/TTC, all requested/completed/waiting/removed/teleported counts, fixed-H and separate-drain total/role/origin boundary time and external wait, ramp exposure/event realization, latch/unknown/terminal-release counts. Report all pairs and repeat hashes.
acceptance: No collision/removal/teleport; all requests complete by bounded drain, physical lanes retained and events realized. Comfort <=2.05 m/s3 for every case; total primary boundary time <= baseline*1.05 for each case as a predeclared engineering cost screen, with every group burden still reported. Passing these inspected fixtures is not scientific or physical acceptance.
viewer: Compose immutable baseline and primary ramp-44 traces on two copies of the current source-fitted I-110 road in one Isaac replay; original source IDs/time and lane/world coordinates remain traceable. SUMO owns motion, no Isaac traffic physics. Use locally generated vehicle visuals in the portable package so the supplied private car is not a dependency. Verify all poses/headings/visibility, source layers unchanged, render and inspect, then open GUI.
github: Read current remote head and paths; prepare a concrete local portable road/replay package and progress handoff. No publication inferred from the status question; no shared Doc writes.
limits: Previously inspected synthetic seed; provisional road/demand; exact simulator state, 240 m is an information advantage. Unknown merge intent and other-motion assumptions. No learned policy/training, empirical safety, physical driving or communication benefit.
